title: Fibre products of algebraic spaces and pullback of etale coverings
statement: Let $S$ be a scheme [def-pc-scheme], let $F,G,H$ be algebraic spaces over $S$ [def-trf-algebraic-space], and let $F\to H$, $G\to H$ be morphisms. The sheaf fibre product $F\times_HG$ is an algebraic space and is a fibre product in the category of algebraic spaces over $S$. If $\{H_i\to H\}_{i\in I}$ is a jointly surjective etale family of algebraic spaces and $G\to H$ is any morphism, then $\{G\times_HH_i\to G\}_{i\in I}$ is again a jointly surjective etale family. Here scheme fibre products are [def-pc-fibre-product], and etale maps of algebraic spaces are representable as in [def-trf-algebraic-space]; in particular $G\times_HH_i$ is a scheme if $G$ is a scheme and $H_i\to H$ is etale.
